page: Microsoft Azure M32dms_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv2 family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated vCPUs. The server is equipped with 875.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 27.34 GB of RAM per core. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 1049 GB SSD. It is also premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The server does not include any GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing tasks. Additionally, it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M32dms_v2 represents a specialized hardware class where the primary value lies in its high memory-to-vCPU ratio. This resource density makes it a candidate for large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data-warehousing workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities for these memory-bound enterprise applications.
